address: Stadsloket Zuidoost, Anton de Komplein 150, Amsterdam (2006 red-brick civic office on a glazed arcade)
notes: 2006 civic office on Anton de Komplein (pand 0363100012078772, 121 LoD2.2 surfaces, roof max 32.8 m); the whole pand is modelled. South-west front (surfaces 15/60, 2019-06-26 panorama w03-241): dark red brick, four storeys of small and long-ribbon windows set in the brick, over a tall fully glazed ground storey carried on white square piers, a long ribbon window box (a projecting glass band) on the fourth storey, wooden double doors under the white lettering Stadsloket on the glazing. North-west front (2025-09-01, w01-331, surface 54/68 and 8/69): the same brick, three storeys of mixed narrow/ribbon windows, a glazed stair core between two brick blocks, a low glazed arcade at both ends.

Signature: 'Stadsloket' lettering MODELLED (kit glazing lettering STADSLOKET in white on the entrance-hall glass, capitals for the photographed lower case); two-storey glazed entrance hall with the timber door colour MODELLED (entrance storeys 2, door colour #b9873f); glazed ground storey MODELLED (ground glazed); the white square piers of the arcade SIMPLIFIED (the kit piers option runs the whole wall height, so it is off: the arcade reads as a continuous glazed storey); the long projecting ribbon window box on the fourth storey SKIPPED (too-small: 3 m by 1 m, 0.4 m proud, no component); the brick window pattern SIMPLIFIED to a regular low-window grid (16 bays); glazed stair core on the north-west front SKIPPED (inside 3DBAG volume); the stairs and flower planters in front SKIPPED (temporary).

South-east and north-east walls (surfaces 74/87 etc.) have no panorama in range (candidates 0): surface 74/87 carries an INFERRED regular window grid copied from the north-west front so the 79 m wall is not a blank slab; the stepped taller blocks (58/121, 19/71/73, 101, 14) stay blank.
